tone_statements.quote: 16. — NEMI. Aire : Haute Hienghène, Haute Taméla, Ouango, Tendo, Coulna. 700 Indigènes. I PHONÉTIQUE. § 1. — Transcription. Mêmes voyelles et consonnes qu'en POAI. § 2. — Accent et ton. neole = le nôtre : bas et sourd. neodu = à nous deux | neole = le leur : haut et sonore. neodu = à eux deux.
tone_statements.translation: 16. Nemi. Area: upper Hienghène, upper Taméla, Ouango, Tendo, Coulna. 700 natives. I. Phonetics. §1 Transcription: same vowels and consonants as in Poai [Fwâi]. §2 Accent and tone: neole 'ours' — low and muffled [voiceless]; neodu 'to us two' | neole 'theirs' — high and sonorous [voiced]; neodu 'to them two'.

audit.reasoning: (1) Quote verified verbatim at the stated place (BSLP 70(1) p. 351, §1.2, last dash item) in the djvu text we hold, and duplicated in the held JSO 1975 Persée scanned (pp. 401-402). (2) The deciding source is a primary 1975 phonology article by the language's principal describer; Glottolog's entire descriptive bibliography for Nemi is three items by her, and a web search (LACITO author page, COCOON/Pangloss, Persée, Diachronica 2025 Lionnet on Paicî, general queries) turned up no later grammar, instrumental or prosodic study of Nemi. (3) Unheld items that could refine the record are the same author's 1979 sketch and 1982 comparative phonology (print/lending only) and J.-C. Rivierre 1993 (JSTOR, not loadable); none is open. J.-C.
